products.name: Staff Pick - Blue Cheese
products.tagline: You choose the texture & the flavor, we'll choose the cheese!
products.description: If you are reading this, you like blue cheese. Well, we do too! Here's all you do: just choose the texture, flavor & the amount and we'll do the rest! Based on your answers, we'll choose a cheese that we love and that fits your criteria - couldn't be easier! It's just like standing in front of the cheese case! Feel free to add any specifics in the Instructions/Additions field at checkout. The published price per lb is only a place holder - the exact price of the cheese will be determined by the amount selected and the actual price per lb of the cheese selected

products.name: Persille de Rambouillet
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Ferme de la Tremblaye - Ile-de-France, France
products.description: This unbelievably smooth ash-coated goat milk blue comes from La Tremblaye dairy, located in the countryside surrounding Paris. Persille de Rambouillet gets its name from its “parsley-veined” interior—persille—and the Rambouillet forest adjacent to the dairy’s picturesque farmland. With a supple texture and notes of white pepper and sweet cream, this blue is, well...amazing. Huge staff favorite!

products.name: Stichelton
products.tagline: Raw Cow - Joe Schneider - Nottinghamshire, UK
products.description: The other King of Blues, Stichelton is Stilton’s raw-milk cousin. Joe Schneider and Neal’s Yard Dairy Founding Director Randolph Hodgeson set out to make a raw-milk Stilton after 18 years of extinction. Since 2006, it has been handmade at Stichelton Dairy in Nottinghamshire. Ladled by hand, the range of flavors this soft, creamy raw milk blue can exhibit is extraordinary – from crisp, green apples to beef stock. We don’t have Stichelton all the time. When we do, you shouldn’t miss it!

products.name: Bayley Hazen Blue
products.tagline: Raw Cow - Jasper Hill Creamery - Greensboro, VT
products.description: DeLaurenti is proud to carry some of Jasper Hill's finest cheeses. Bayley Hazen is a favorite of both customers and staff alike. Initially assertive, Bayley Hazen finishes with soft, sweet and grassy flavors. It's perfect for topping a burger or crumbling onto a salad. Also great paired with green apples and a glass of port.

products.name: Bleu d'Auvergne
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Terre des Volcans - Auvergne, France
products.description: Sometimes referred to as the cow's milk version of Roquefort, Bleu d'Auvergne is much creamier and more approachable. Rather buttery with a subtle, earthy grassiness, this blue is assertive enough for your cheese board, but also perfect as a recipe ingredient. Great for everything from making steak butter to stuffing dates.

products.name: Bleu des Causses
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Mons Fromagerie - Midi-Pyrenees, France
products.description: This lesser known cousin to Roquefort is made with 100% raw cow's milk, and was originally a less expensive alternative for those who couldn't afford the highly prized King of French Blues. It is assertive and full flavored, but remains approachable. Another Herve Mons triumph. With hints of grass and earth, it is an interesting blue that is perfect when you feel like trying something new. Fantastic with any wines from the Languedoc in Southern France.

products.name: Blu Di Cuneo
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Caseificio Rabbia - Piedmont, Italy
products.description:
The result of a collective effort of a recently formed association of traditional cheesemakers from the Cuneo area, this spoonable blue is bursting with mouthwatering flavors. Each producer involved crafts this enticing blue cheese that is typical of the area according to traditional recipes and methods, to preserve and recognize this local cheese officially. Blu di Cuneo is similar in consistency to its neighboring blue somewhere between a gorgonzola dolce and gorgonzola cremificato, but inoculated with the penicillium roqueforti mold for a distinct difference in flavor from the former: rich and sweet notes of cultured cream intermingle with more savory mineral notes with a bit of brine on the finish, delivered in a compellingly creamy and pudding like paste sure to please most palates.

Caseificio Rabbia is dedicated to preserving the local traditional cheeses that are integral ingredients in the Piedmontese cuisine. They are located in Raffia near Cuneo - at the foothills of the Alps where they also have a special maturation cave that provides the perfect environment to capture the unique microbial character of the region. These flora in turn, populate on the cheese’s natural rinds, and ultimately aid in cultivating the resulting flavors in the finished cheese. These understated flavors are expressive of the native environment and lend a depth and unique character to this otherwise deceptively subtle class of cheeses. Currently in their 5th generation, the Rabbia family is dedicated to producing raw milk cheese, made from local herds within 1 kilometer of their facility. The resulting tomas are soothing, subtle and extremely snackable.

products.name: Chevretta Blauw
products.tagline: Pasteurized Goat - Treur Kaas - Winkel, Netherlands
products.description: Chevretta Blauw is a farmstead goat’s milk gouda with blue mold. While that may sound like a divisive cheese, trust us on this one. The cheese has a delicately creamy texture thanks to the high quality milk and added cream. The lightly caramelized sweetness characteristic of a goat gouda balances perfectly with the minerality of the blue mold. Grab a wedge and see why our staff has so quickly fallen for this cheese!

products.name: Fourme d'Ambert
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Terre des Volcans - Auvergne, France
products.description: One of France's oldest cheeses, the production of Fourme d'Ambert dates back to Roman times. Named for its tall and narrow cylindrical shape, it is customarily cut into disks rather than wedges. This makes an eye-catching addition to any cheese platter. It is earthy and mushroomy, with a dense creamy texture. Perfect on a burger, with dried fruit, honey, or a glass of port.

products.name: Glacier Blue
products.tagline: Raw Cow - Cascadia Creamery - Trout Lake, WA
products.description: Cascadia Creamery is committed to sustainable and humane practices and has been certified organic for decades - they also happen to make really great cheese. Their cows graze happily on the meadow grasses enriched by the volcanic soil of Mt. Adams. Glacier Blue is rich, dense and approachable, making it a great blue for all occasions. Perfect on everything from a cheese plate to a burger to a salad. Even suitable for dessert with honey and candied nuts.

products.name: Gorgonzola Piccante
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Formaggi Ciresa - Lombardy, Italy
products.description: Slightly more aged and firm than its sweeter counterpart, Gorgonzola Piccante is densely creamy. The paste is light yellow with widespread blue and green marbling. With a robust and sharp flavor, this is perfect for crumbling on top (or inside) a burger. Its creamy texture is also suitable for melting into a sauce, or using as part of your filling for ravioli. Great with roasted walnuts, honey and bright fruits for dessert.

products.name: Mitibleu
products.tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Mitica - Castilla la Mancha, Spain
products.description: Mitibleu is a rare sheep’s milk blue from Spain that was originally designed to rival the famous French blue, Roquefort. This cheese is produced in a dairy near the medieval city of Toledo, in the heart of Manchego country. The milk used comes from the plentiful sheep that graze on the plains of La Mancha. Mitibleu is aged 4 months, with a bold and spicy flavor. Although full of flavor, it packs less bite than its French inspiration.

products.name: Roquefort
products.tagline: Raw Sheep - Gabriel Coulet - Aveyron, France
products.description: Roquefort is the undisputed King of French Blues. Roquefort starts with baking loaves of rye. After aging for a few weeks, this bread will yield an entire year's supply of penicillium roqueforti, the mold used to inoculate the cheese curds. This mold, combined with raw sheep's milk, give Roquefort its unique character. Could it get better? Well...this one is aged by famed French affineur Herver Mons as well! Aromas are powerful, with notes of bread and yeast. The texture is crumbly yet creamy, with a taste that is at once pleasantly salty, sweet, briny and piquant. Roquefort is amazing on its own, on a salad, or with a glass of Sauternes.

products.name: Saint Agur
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Fromagerie de Chaumes - Auvergne, France
products.description: Looking for a crowd-pleasing blue? There's a reason we sell a lot of this pasteurized cow's milk cheese from France's volcanic central Auvergne region. Saint Agur is an irresistibly buttery double-cream cheese threaded with spicy blue veins. The texture is soft, creamy & spreadable with a pale cream-colored paste. Not only is it perfect for a cheese board, its ultra-creamy texture makes it excellent to incorporate into salad dressings & sauces for grilled steak.

products.name: Stilton
products.tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Colston Bassett/Neal's Yard Dairy - Nottinghamshire, England
products.description: Founded in 1913, and still one of the smallest Stilton dairies in the UK, Colston Bassett uses more traditional methods than most other Stilton producers. The curd is still hand-ladled before draining, which preserves its structure, resulting in a luscious, creamy texture when the cheeses are mature. The rind is a mottled orange-brown with patches of natural white mold. Flavors are rich and lactic with a wonderful balance of blue mold, earth and butter. In the end, you will not enjoy a more fantastic blue cheese. Enjoy as is, use it to top your favorite steak hot off the grill, or enjoy it with candied nuts and a glass of port for dessert.
